dashboard.default: Scan, review candidates, and reclaim disk space.
dashboard.searchStopped: Directory search stopped. Sizing found items — click Stop analysis to skip the rest.

header.quarantine: Restore or permanently purge held folders.
header.history: Review past scans and reuse configurations.
header.settings: Configure scan targets, safety, and discovery options.

actions.quickUpdateTitleRecommended: Recommended for repeat scans — reuses inventory; much faster on HDD when paths are unchanged.
actions.quickUpdateTitleDefault: Reuse cached classify/size for unchanged paths. Run a full scan after changing profile or discovery options.

empty.title: Need more disk space?
empty.description: Run the guided flow to scan your projects, review safe targets, and quarantine clutter with one click — nothing is permanently deleted until you purge quarantine.

scanTargets.title: Scan targets
scanTargets.ready: Choose drives or folders, then run Scan Now.
scanTargets.notReady: Select at least one drive or custom folder before scanning.

candidates.groupHint: Recommended for large scans — expand a project to see each artifact.
candidates.searchStoppedBanner: Directory search has stopped. Sizes are still being calculated — use Stop analysis in the header to skip the rest. Rows without a size yet show Sizing….

detail.title: Candidate Detail
detail.selectPrompt: Select an item to inspect its metadata.
detail.gitNone: No git history for this path (or git unavailable).

planner.title: Free Space Planner
planner.noScan: Run a scan to see how much space you can reclaim, then set a target and auto-select candidates.
planner.targetNotReached: Could not reach that target with current scan results. Try a lower goal or include review-tier items.

settings.title: Global Configuration
settings.description: Safety profile, discovery options, and advanced scan behavior. Configure drives and folders on the Dashboard. Changes apply after you save.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language for labels and navigation. Stored on this device.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Desktop builds are distributed via GitHub Releases (Windows MSI / NSIS).
updates.checkDescription: Compares this install with the latest release on GitHub Releases · detected {{platform}}.
updates.latest: You are on the latest release ({{tag}}).
updates.installFinish: — follow the installer to finish, then restart Deco.
updates.extractManual: — extract or install manually, then restart Deco.

scanBehavior.title: Scan behavior
scanBehavior.descriptionPartition: Pick a cleanup profile for your role, then tune scan strategy and thresholds. Scan scope applies when suggesting roots on empty drives.
scanBehavior.descriptionCustom: Pick a cleanup profile for your role, then tune scan strategy and thresholds. Custom-folder mode ignores partition layout.
scanBehavior.customMismatchProfile: Safety profile, discovery flags, or scope no longer match a preset — adjust below or pick a profile.
scanBehavior.customMismatchStrategy: Depth, size parallelism, or Quick update no longer match a preset — adjust below or pick a preset.
scanBehavior.profileBundleHint: Bundles scope, safety profile, discovery flags, and scan strategy.
scanBehavior.strategyBundleHint: Maps to search depth, size parallelism, and Quick update.

performance.title: Performance tuning
performance.hint: Adjusting these may switch the strategy to Custom.
performance.gitDormancyDesc: When a candidate is selected, run git log for last commit touching that path. Opt-in; does not affect scan speed.
performance.quickUpdateDesc: Reuse classify and size for unchanged paths. Run a full scan after changing profile or discovery options.
performance.fastSize: Fast size estimate for dependency trees
performance.fastSizeDesc: Sample top-level packages in node_modules, target, and similar folders instead of walking every file (shows ~size). Reduces 30s timeouts on huge trees.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.shiftHint: Shift+click to toggle a range between two rows.

general.label: General
general.description: Scan performance and high-risk project targets.

package_managers.label: Package managers
package_managers.description: Global caches for Node, Python, Conda, bun, NuGet, and Composer (review tier).

language_runtimes.label: Language runtimes
language_runtimes.description: Compiler and runtime caches outside individual projects.

include_size.label: Calculate sizes
include_size.description: Turn off for a faster scan (CLI: --no-size).

include_python_venv.label: Include Python venv
include_python_venv.description: venv / .venv when a Python project is detected (high risk).

check_npm_cache.label: npm cache
check_npm_cache.description: npm cache directory with _cacache (regenerate: npm cache clean).

check_pnpm_store.label: pnpm store
check_pnpm_store.description: Global store and project `.pnpm-store` folders (v3 marker); respects PNPM_STORE_PATH / pnpm store path.

check_yarn_cache.label: Yarn cache
check_yarn_cache.description: Yarn Classic (v6) or Berry global cache; uses yarn cache dir when available.

check_pip_cache.label: pip cache
check_pip_cache.description: pip download cache (wheels/http); regen with pip cache purge.

check_uv_cache.label: uv cache
check_uv_cache.description: uv package cache; respects UV_CACHE_DIR / uv cache dir.

check_conda_pkgs_cache.label: Conda pkgs cache
check_conda_pkgs_cache.description: Conda/Miniconda package cache (pkgs only; never envs/). Regenerate: conda clean.

check_bun_cache.label: bun cache
check_bun_cache.description: Global bun install cache; respects BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR.

check_go_cache.label: Global Go cache
check_go_cache.description: Opt-in scan for GOCACHE and GOMODCACHE via go env.

check_cargo_registry.label: Cargo registry cache
check_cargo_registry.description: CARGO_HOME/registry with downloaded crates (regenerate: cargo cache -a).

check_vcpkg_cache.label: vcpkg installed tree
check_vcpkg_cache.description: VCPKG_ROOT/installed ports (review; reinstall with vcpkg install).

check_conan_cache.label: Conan package cache
check_conan_cache.description: Conan 2 global package cache (.conan2/p; review tier).

check_ccache.label: ccache
check_ccache.description: Compiler object cache (CCACHE_DIR or ~/.cache/ccache; review tier).

check_bazel_disk_cache.label: Bazel disk cache
check_bazel_disk_cache.description: When BAZEL_DISK_CACHE points at a directory with Bazel disk-cache layout (cas/ac subdirs; review tier).

check_ide_global_cache.label: IDE global caches
check_ide_global_cache.description: Xcode DerivedData plus JetBrains/Android Studio caches when smart discovery is on.

smart_discovery_enabled.label: Smart discovery
smart_discovery_enabled.description: Match declarative path patterns (e.g. Android Studio caches) to registered kinds. Requires the matching opt-in flags.

policyPack.title: Policy pack gallery
policyPack.description: Browse shipped examples, preview JSON, see replace diff, and apply .deco/disk-cleanup.json to a project.
policyPack.intro: Shipped examples from the repo gallery. Select one to preview JSON, then apply to a project folder.
policyPack.replaceWarning: The entire file will be replaced; merge fields manually if needed.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: How cleanup frees space. Use Delete when the drive is almost full.
safety.deleteInPlace: Delete in place (recommended) — frees space immediately, no copy
safety.quarantineSameDrive: Quarantine on same drive — moves to .deco-quarantine, restorable
safety.deleteHint: Delete in place does not store backups. Use it when cleaning C: or when the disk is almost full.
safety.diskHdd: HDD / sequential — one folder at a time
safety.diskHint: HDD mode deletes one tree at a time (best for mechanical drives). Pause/resume is available during cleanup.
safety.fastDeleteDesc: When deleting in place, removes node_modules, target, and build folders via system commands (Windows rmdir /s /q, Unix rm -rf). Parallelism follows Settings → Cleanup disk mode (HDD = one tree at a time) and Scan behavior → Performance. Not used for quarantine.
safety.quarantineEnableHint: Enable by choosing “Quarantine on same drive” above. Payloads are never stored under AppData unless you pick that folder yourself.
safety.quarantineCustom: Custom folder — you choose the path
safety.systemDriveWarning: This folder is on the system (C:) drive — quarantine will use space on C:.
safety.classifyHint: Rayon classify runs when a chunk has at least this many targets (default 8).

first_scan.label: First scan
first_scan.description: Conservative safety, thorough walk, all scope — audit before enabling global caches.

monorepo_maintainer.label: Monorepo maintainer
monorepo_maintainer.description: Balanced defaults with package-manager and registry caches plus smart IDE patterns.

ci_agent.label: CI agent
ci_agent.description: Fast shallow pass, drive roots, compiler caches — typical build-agent reclaim.

thorough.label: Thorough
thorough.description: Deeper search, balanced parallelism — best for first scan or audit.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Default trade-off for most machines and repeat scans.

fast.label: Fast
fast.description: Shallower walk, 8 parallel workers — SSD / NVMe friendly.

background.label: Background
background.description: Gentle disk use — 2 workers, shallow walk (HDD).

cleanupDiskMode.hdd: HDD / sequential — one folder at a time
